title: I Sought The Lord and Afterward  I Knew
lyrics_original: I sought the Lord, and afterward I knew
He moved my soul to seek Him, seeking me.
It was not I that found, O Savior true,
No, I was found of Thee.
Thou didst reach forth Thy hand and mine enfold,
I walked and sank not on the storm-vexed sea.
‘Twas not so much that I on Thee took hold
As Thou, dear Lord, on me.
I find, I walk, I love, but, oh, the whole
Of love is but my answer, Lord, to Thee!
For Thou wert long beforehand with my soul,

bible_verses.english: You didn’t choose me, but I chose you, and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.
In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.

For whom he foreknew, he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers. 30 And whom he predestined, those he also called. Whom he called, those he also justified. Whom he justified, those he also glorified.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for seeking me long before I ever thought to seek You. When I am tossed by life's uncertain storms, help me remember that it is Your faithful hand holding me secure. My love for You is only a small echo of the immense love You have poured into my heart. Keep my heart humble and resting peacefully in Your beautiful grace today. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: It often feels as though we were the ones searching for God, but this comforting hymn reminds us that He was seeking us all along. Every moment of longing, every step of faith, and every act of love is simply our soul's quiet response to the Savior who first reached out to us. When the storms of life threaten to overwhelm us, it is not our feeble grip on Christ that saves us, but His strong and unyielding hand holding us fast. Today, rest in the joy of knowing that you are fully known, pursued, and held by His everlasting grace.
